title: Unspun — September 29, 2026
description: Fourteen verified stories from September 28: the nor'easter's end and the forecast ahead, oil past $107 and a possible diesel export ban, 70% odds of an October Fed hike, the undisclosed Iranian attack that injured eight Marines, Gulf oil exports back to 72% of prewar levels, Smotrich's West Bank call and the U.N. Security Council session, EU sanctions and sabotage warnings, India's new digital-payment fees, the Senate's college sports overhaul, Alito's recusal from the Boulder climate case, the SAVE voter-database ruling, Starship's first orbit, Pennsylvania's measles outbreak, and a pediatric GLP-1 study. Facts only, no spin.
